<documents>
<document id="plan-basic">
TheˆBasicˆplanˆBasicˆisˆTallowbrook'sˆfreeˆplan.ˆTheˆmonthlyˆfeeˆisˆ$0.00,ˆthere'sˆnoˆminimumˆbalance,ˆandˆyouˆgetˆtheˆsameˆapp,ˆdebitˆcardˆandˆsupportˆasˆeveryˆotherˆmember.ˆ##ˆWhat'sˆincludedˆ-ˆ**Monthlyˆfee:**ˆ$0.00ˆ-ˆ**ATMs:**ˆfreeˆatˆBrookLinkˆATMs.ˆOut-of-networkˆwithdrawalsˆcostˆ$2.50ˆeach.ˆ-ˆ**Foreignˆtransactionˆfee:**ˆ3%ˆofˆtheˆpurchaseˆamountˆ-ˆ**Cardˆreplacement:**ˆ$5.00ˆ-ˆ**Expeditedˆcardˆshipping:**ˆ$25.00ˆ-ˆ**SavingsˆPockets:**ˆ0.50%ˆAPYˆ-ˆ**Cushion:**ˆnotˆavailableˆonˆBasicˆ-ˆ**Dailyˆcardˆspendingˆlimit:**ˆ$3,000ˆ-ˆ**DailyˆATMˆlimit:**ˆ$500ˆ##ˆGoodˆtoˆknowˆInternationalˆwiresˆaren'tˆavailableˆonˆBasic.ˆYouˆcanˆstillˆreceiveˆthem.ˆIfˆyouˆtravelˆorˆsendˆmoneyˆabroadˆoften,ˆPlusˆorˆPremiumˆwillˆusuallyˆcostˆlessˆoverˆaˆyear.ˆYouˆcanˆchangeˆplansˆanyˆtimeˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆProfile,ˆthenˆPlan.ˆUpgradesˆstartˆrightˆaway.ˆDowngradesˆstartˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="fee-changes-2026">
WhatˆchangedˆinˆtheˆMarchˆ2026ˆfeeˆupdateˆWeˆupdatedˆourˆfeesˆonˆMarchˆ1,ˆ2026.ˆHere'sˆeverythingˆthatˆchangedˆandˆwhatˆstayedˆtheˆsame.ˆ##ˆWhatˆchangedˆ-ˆ**Plusˆmonthlyˆfee:**ˆfromˆ$4.00ˆtoˆ$5.00.ˆ-ˆ**Plusˆforeignˆtransactionˆfee:**ˆfromˆ1.5%ˆtoˆ1%.ˆ-ˆ**Out-of-networkˆATMˆfeeˆonˆBasicˆandˆPlus:**ˆfromˆ$2.00ˆtoˆ$2.50ˆperˆwithdrawal.ˆ-ˆ**Plusˆfreeˆout-of-networkˆwithdrawals:**ˆfromˆ2ˆtoˆ3ˆaˆmonth.ˆ##ˆWhatˆstayedˆtheˆsameˆBasicˆisˆstillˆfree.ˆPremiumˆisˆstillˆ$15.00ˆaˆmonthˆwithˆnoˆATMˆorˆforeignˆtransactionˆfees.ˆCardˆreplacement,ˆwireˆandˆcashˆdepositˆfeesˆdidn'tˆchangeˆonˆanyˆplan.ˆ##ˆWhyˆweˆmadeˆtheseˆchangesˆOut-of-networkˆATMˆoperatorsˆraisedˆwhatˆtheyˆchargeˆus,ˆandˆweˆmovedˆpartˆofˆthatˆcostˆintoˆtheˆfee.ˆWeˆloweredˆtheˆPlusˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆatˆtheˆsameˆtime,ˆsoˆPlusˆmembersˆwhoˆtravelˆpayˆlessˆoverall.ˆIfˆtheˆnewˆPlusˆpriceˆdoesn'tˆworkˆforˆyou,ˆyouˆcanˆmoveˆtoˆBasicˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆTheˆchangeˆtakesˆeffectˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="wires-incoming">
ReceivingˆaˆwireˆYouˆcanˆreceiveˆdomesticˆandˆinternationalˆwiresˆintoˆyourˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆonˆanyˆplan.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆgiveˆtheˆsenderˆYourˆroutingˆnumber,ˆaccountˆnumber,ˆfullˆlegalˆnameˆandˆaddressˆareˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆAccountˆdetails,ˆthenˆWireˆinstructions.ˆInternationalˆsendersˆalsoˆneedˆourˆSWIFTˆcode,ˆshownˆonˆtheˆsameˆscreen.ˆ##ˆFeesˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆIncomingˆdomesticˆwireˆ|ˆIncomingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆ|---|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ$10.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ$10.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ##ˆTimingˆDomesticˆwiresˆusuallyˆarriveˆwithinˆhoursˆonˆaˆbusinessˆday.ˆInternationalˆwiresˆcanˆtakeˆlonger,ˆdependingˆonˆtheˆsendingˆbank.ˆ##ˆIfˆaˆwireˆhasn'tˆarrivedˆAskˆtheˆsenderˆforˆtheˆwireˆreferenceˆnumberˆandˆtheˆdateˆitˆwasˆsent,ˆthenˆmessageˆsupport.ˆWiresˆwithˆaˆnameˆthatˆdoesn'tˆmatchˆyourˆaccountˆnameˆmayˆbeˆreturnedˆtoˆtheˆsender.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
